principles: A retracted claim must leave the heading, because the heading is what gets quoted (COMPLEXITY_LADDER §0)
A timestamp is not an identifier: attribute via the dispatch's own walkLog/goal_reasoning, never a shared-journal grep. Violated 4+ times (COMPLEXITY_LADDER §2-3, COMPOSITIONALITY_STATE §15.36)
Identical goal text coalesces, so an A/B reusing text measures one execution (COMPLEXITY_LADDER §2)
A zero read through a filter measures the filter; a returned-row count is not a table total; a failed page is not an empty page (COMPLEXITY_LADDER §5, COMPOSITION_LEARNING_STATE)
Close and reject are not interchangeable: closed is a landed-fix training label (COMPLEXITY_LADDER §6)
When fixing a class, grep the twin/sibling call sites: dead-store gate, tcExit, shell/bash vs shellResult x4, floor vs walk guard (COMPLEXITY_LADDER §7, COMPOSITIONALITY_STATE §15.41)

Absence-of-write is the frontier. A trace-driven immune system cannot see a store that stops being written; the missing predicate is 'something that should be written or alive is not' (COMPOSITIONALITY_STATE §9.1/9.4)
A detector must run where its data lives or distinguish not-written from not-visible-from-here (COMPOSITIONALITY_STATE §15.3)
A masked unit that is running defeats every recovery mechanism; assert that no running vessel's unit is masked (COMPOSITIONALITY_STATE §15.34)
A partition of roles can be complete on each side and still lose a member (COMPOSITIONALITY_STATE §15.53)
Validate a fix against the live system before dispatching it; the database reveals the full constraint set in seconds (COMPOSITIONALITY_STATE §15.12)
Time the operation in the environment it runs in (compose worktree is not the live tree) (§15.11.1)
'Fix landed and nothing changed' has two readings: not deployed yet, or a second defect downstream (§15.7.1)
One op at one distinctive anchor predicts landing; a partially-correct multi-op plan is worth nothing (§15.10)
An absent marker means NOT OBSERVED, not FAILED. Violated at verify, refuter and cutover layers (§11.5, §15.19, §15.20)
Evidence supply beats decision rules and instructions (6/6 vs 0/10). Refined: concrete values transfer, procedure does not; a supplied fact cannot compose wrongly (§15.37, §15.51, §15.59)
Law 8 changed what the system tried; gates only changed what it was allowed to keep (§15.49)
Grounding is not freshness: for time-varying values, retrieval without a timestamp is indistinguishable from fabrication (§15.23, §15.47)
An oracle that disagrees with a peer source is not an oracle until something independent arbitrates (§15.47)
A negative reproduction only refutes the conditions you actually recreated (§15.39)
When a dependency's latency is bimodal across orders of magnitude, suspect the dependency's state before tuning the caller (§15.58)
Retrying a failing compose is not free: residue accumulates in the shared clone (§15.20)
A correction that does not reach the consumer is not a correction (reach override vs reached-command cache) (§15.30)
The substrate has no path from 'this has never worked' to 'stop selecting it'. Retirement plus recipe eviction are the missing half of law 3 (§15.33-35)
One disease in four stores: an action that reports success while changing nothing (retirement, cache, masked unit, grader) (§15.35, §15.40)
The system knows what it is but not what it is currently doing: descriptive self-knowledge is strong, reflexive self-knowledge is missing (§12.3)

Bind what the schema requires, name what the query needs, and make every seam emit a counter at the consuming layer. Counters need a non-human runtime reader (ARCHITECTURE_2026-08-21 §2, Appendix A law 2)
A detector must be proven to complete (broken fixture exits 1), not merely to exist (ARCHITECTURE_2026-08-21 §2.4)
Operator failure delays work without destroying it: the demand survives as a gap and the autonomous lane closes it (3e76227, fef173c, b10c3f2) (§11.11, §15.4, §15.6)
Pre-register falsifiers and make no in-run repairs; setup failures are findings, never passes; check HTTP status and payload separately (coldboot PREREG, container-lifecycle REPORT)
A test whose form can be satisfied without doing the work is not a test (the epoch field) (§15.25)
Guidance that generalises past its evidence is how a fix becomes a defect (§15.31)
The reach gate is only as good as the oracle on the target shape; a write-shaped goal graded on the write passes a durable wrong answer (COMPLEXITY_LADDER §5)
A validation stack that derives its reference from the same source as the thing it validates cannot detect that source being wrong (§14)
